user.title: Connect to LikeHub
user.description:
A LikeHub account is required. If you don't have one yet, [sign up]({signup_url}) and create a site, then come back here.

The password is used once to obtain tokens and is never stored.

site.title: Select site
site.description: Your account has several sites. Choose the one this Home Assistant installation serves.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for {email}. Site settings will be preserved.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the server

init.title: LikeHub settings
init.description:
Entities sent: {entities}, sensor groups: {groups}.

Until something is selected, nothing leaves your home.

add_device.title: Select a device
add_device.description: Pick the device whose data goes to the cloud. On the next step you choose which of its readings to send.

data_description.device: Only devices with sensors, switches or valves are listed. Entities without a device — helpers, for instance — are added as groups in the neighbouring section.

device_entities.title: What to send from this device
device_entities.description:
{device} — tick the readings that go to the cloud. The current value is shown next to each one.

Unticking stops that reading from being sent.

data_description.add_another: Returns to device selection; your ticks are kept.

groups.title: Whole sensor groups
groups.description: A group covers every matching entity in the home, including ones added later. Handy when there are too many sensors to list one by one.

data_description.group_sensor: Temperature, humidity, battery level — sensor domain
data_description.group_binary_sensor: Leak, smoke, door opening, motion — binary_sensor domain
data_description.group_switch: On or off state — switch domain

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: What else is sent, and how often.

data.min_interval: No more than one sync per

data_description.send_telemetry: Numeric sensor readings. Alarms for the selected entities are always sent, regardless of this setting.
data_description.min_interval: A floor, not a period: the server sets the interval itself (usually 5 minutes) and cannot go below this value.

remote.title: Remote control
remote.description:
The master switch for command execution. While it is off, the agent performs nothing that arrives from the cloud.

Command delivery arrives in the second version of the service: until then the server returns an empty list, so there is nothing to map devices to yet.

data_description.allow_remote_control: The same switch exists as an entity — automations can turn it off, for example while nobody is home.

error.device_without_entities: This device has no readings suitable for sending. Pick another one.

access_revoked.title: Access revoked
access_revoked.description: The service revoked access for this site. Re-authenticate in the integration settings.

site_blocked.title: Site blocked
site_blocked.description: The service blocked this site. Data sending has stopped. Contact support.

site_not_found.title: Site not found
site_not_found.description: The service does not know this site. It may have been deleted. Reinstall the integration.

roles_not_mapped.title: Roles not mapped
roles_not_mapped.description: Remote control is enabled but no role is mapped to an entity. Commands will be rejected.
